text: MD Anderson, the Houston Dynamo front sponsor, is part of the University of Texas System.
short: MD Anderson is part of the University of Texas System.

source.name: UT MD Anderson – About UT MD Anderson ('Part of the University of Texas System')
source.quote: Part of the University of Texas System, UT MD Anderson is one of the world’s most respected centers devoted exclusively to cancer patient care, research, education and prevention.
